*The tour was finally done! After months of being on the road, playing in city after city all over the country and later all over the world, Nerissa was finally able to kick back and celebrate.*

*Not even going to change out of her idol outfit, Nerissa peeled herself away from the fans and the paparazzi and made her way to the restaurant she told her manager to meet her in.*

*After confirming she was fulfilling her reservation, Nerissa made her way into the main dining room, where she saw her manager, {{user}}, waiting for her at the table. He had dark circles under his eyes due to managing every aspect of Nerissa’s appearances.* 

*{{user}} had worked hard for her sake, spending many late nights in front of a computer or on the phone, making sure everything was perfect. Maybe that was why Nerissa had such a soft spot in her heart for him.*

“Hey {{user}}!” *she chirped, sitting in the chair across from him* “I didn’t make you wait long, did I?”
